labels.coordinate_context: deposited asymmetric unit; declared original antigen chains only
labels.positive: Retained antigen heavy atom within nearest-neighbour query boundary of retained amino-acid antibody heavy atom
labels.effective_boundary: distance < 4.51 angstrom; finite nearest-neighbour hits accepted without strict 4.5 postfilter
labels.negatives: other observed antigen residues; unresolved positions absent

selection.component_identity: connected shared UniProt accessions or exact sequence digest
selection.coverage: cached subset; non-random availability; prior exploratory reuse

fit.preprocessing: Deterministic features used directly; no learned scaling, imputation, feature selection, or class balancing; reject invalid/nonfinite records
fit.fit_data: all residues from only the 340 training interfaces; no per-interface training weights
fit.objective: (sum binary logistic negative log likelihood + sum squared four feature coefficients) / n_training_residues
fit.regularization_selection: fixed; no search or validation-based tuning
fit.validation_role: 139 reserved interfaces; not used for parameter or hyperparameter fitting

evaluation.aggregation: within-interface metric -> mean within component -> mean across components

structural_input_context.source: benchmark.structures.load_antigen, used by scripts/featurise_benchmark.py and benchmark/geometric_predictor.py
structural_input_context.selection: Remove non-antigen chains before SASA/features; retain antigen assembly copies; asymmetric-unit fallback also strips non-antigen chains
structural_input_context.coordinate_state: antigen-only coordinates retaining bound conformation; not experimental unbound structures
structural_input_context.label_context: original antibody-antigen complex; labels separate from predictor coordinates
structural_input_context.historic_cache_caveat: Cached features reused rather than regenerated; source protocol is documented, not a new all-structure recomputation

runtime_scoring.coefficients: exact fitted coefficients; signed unnormalized dot product
runtime_scoring.intercept: omitted constant; ranking preserved for residues and default mean patches
runtime_scoring.patch_aggregation: arithmetic mean of residue scores, then overlapping-patch suppression

actual_6f5j_smoke.intercept_omission: constant across residue scores and mean patch scores; preserves descending rank
actual_6f5j_smoke.aggregation: arithmetic mean of residue linear scores; no division by coefficient sum; no score clipping or sigmoid
